product_variants_capacity_finite_chk.name: product_variants_capacity_finite_chk
product_variants_capacity_finite_chk.value:
(capacity_mode = 'unlimited' AND capacity_total IS NULL AND capacity_remaining IS NULL)
          OR (capacity_mode = 'finite' AND capacity_total IS NOT NULL AND capacity_remaining IS NOT NULL
              AND capacity_total >= 0 AND capacity_remaining >= 0 AND capacity_remaining <= capacity_total)

orders_amounts_nonneg_chk.name: orders_amounts_nonneg_chk
orders_amounts_nonneg_chk.value: subtotal_toman >= 0 AND fee_toman >= 0 AND fixed_cost_toman >= 0 AND discount_toman >= 0 AND payable_toman >= 0

discounts_percentage_bps_chk.name: discounts_percentage_bps_chk
discounts_percentage_bps_chk.value: percentage_bps IS NULL OR (percentage_bps >= 0 AND percentage_bps <= 10000)
